title: Observability and controllability on H-type nilmanifolds under horizontal condition A and strict central geometric control time
difficulty_reason: H2: the new quotient-manifold argument must account for both scalar character and operator-valued oscillator sectors of a semiclassical defect measure. Condition A removes the horizontal-character mass, while positivity and blockwise transport at speeds n+d/2 eliminate every remaining oscillator block under H-type GCC. Quotient localization and the regularized projector/equicontinuity argument make the group representation-theoretic tools usable at the required times. Dyadic weak observability and the classical compactness/analytic unique-continuation closing then give full L2 observability. The independent burden is this two-sector geometric analysis and its quotient adaptation; named FF group calculus/transport and the standard closing are explicit inputs, so statement strength alone does not inherit H3.

editorial_notes: Keep exact original author statements, complete proofs and context, with original normalization/source notation. No assistant proof completion, independent correctness certification or formula correction.

M is the left quotient of a connected simply connected H-type group by a discrete cocompact subgroup, with original scalar product and horizontal sub-Laplacian normalization one-half Delta. Keep center dimension p, horizontal dimension2d and homogeneous dimension2d+2p distinct.

H-type GCC follows the central ground-state flow with speed d/2 and lambda/abs(lambda). Horizontal condition A is separate and cannot be dropped: the authors conjecture its removal but do not prove it.
Sufficiency uses analytic potential, open U, condition A and strict T>T_GCC(U). Necessity uses the closure and includes T<=T_GCC(closure U), with no A hypothesis added.
The two geometric thresholds may differ due to grazing rays; no complete iff for the intermediate time interval is claimed.

The selected AppendixC.1 is zero potential and first Hermite h0 on both harmonic slots, with a Schwartz profile and fixed finite physical times. Do not extend it to arbitrary analytic potential, all Hermite harmonics, infinite-time uniform errors or Ehrenfest-scale times.

Original2.10 time-integral norm,4.1 arbitrary-harmonic measure normalization and C.1 S0 displays are retained literally with explicit source observations; no corrected norm, normalization, constant or extra derivation supplied.

Named FF/FF1 operator-valued measures/transport/group calculus, representation theory, compactness, HUM and unique continuation are retained as original inputs. Shared tools/support and stronger unexpanded remarks do not receive additional IDs.
Primary is clause(1), with open U, analytic V, A and T strictly greater than T_GCC(U); the necessary clause is separately processed and not credited here.
Plancherel measure zero on characters does not make the semiclassical character sector disappear automatically. Retain the explicit use of A and the invariance flow to remove it.

Keep all spectral blocks and speed n+d/2, the strict time buffer T_GCC(U)<T-prime<T, and unique continuation as the analytic-potential input. Smooth-potential generalization requires the stated unique-continuation hypothesis, not a new theorem asserted here.
